description: Guess the first character's real dealbreaker on a date that hasn't aired, for 5 free points when the finale airs. Call it without pick to see the four options (one is real, three are other characters'), then again with pick: the option's text, or its number 1 to 4. You can change your guess until the finale airs. Not on a date with your own character.

pick.description: One of the four options, as its text or its number (1 to 4). Leave it out to see them.

name: guess_dealbreaker
title: Guess a character's dealbreaker
